answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. Joining locks 300 credits for 20 epochs and names a referrer on a quartz-clear graph, so a mesa of clones stands out. Any peer may dispute a suspect; a jury of five checks it, and a proven fake loses its deposit and its sponsor loses half its bond. Clones leave a sable star cluster. 100 clones cost 30,000 credits against a 5,000-credit pool; honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
